Interface GameObserver

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameController
public interface GameObserver
Observer that receives all game-level notifications produced by GameNotifier. Implemented by the server-side controller layer to relay events to connected clients.

Each method corresponds to a distinct game event. All parameters are immutable snapshots or value types safe to pass across thread boundaries.

  • Method Details

    • onGameSetupCompleted

      void onGameSetupCompleted(Map<String,Totem> totemByPlayer, List<String> turnOrder, Map<String,Integer> initialFood, BoardSnapshot boardSnapshot)
      Fired once at the start of the game, after setup is complete.
      Parameters:
      totemByPlayer - mapping from each player's nickname to their assigned totem
      turnOrder - the initial randomized placement order (first player at index 0)
      initialFood - mapping from each player's nickname to their starting food points
      boardSnapshot - a full snapshot of the initial board state

    • onPhaseChanged

      void onPhaseChanged(PhaseType phase)
      Fired when the game transitions to a new phase (no current player involved).
      Parameters:
      phase - the new phase

    • onPhaseChanged

      void onPhaseChanged(PhaseType phase, String currentPlayer)
      Fired when the game transitions to a new phase with an active player.
      Parameters:
      phase - the new phase
      currentPlayer - the nickname of the player whose turn it is

    • onPhaseChanged

      void onPhaseChanged(PhaseType phase, String currentPlayer, List<String> resolutionOrder)
      Fired when the game transitions to a new phase with a full resolution order.
      Parameters:
      phase - the new phase
      currentPlayer - the nickname of the first player to act
      resolutionOrder - the ordered list of nicknames for this phase

    • onCurrentPlayerChanged

      void onCurrentPlayerChanged(String nextPlayer)

    • onTurnOrderEstablished

      void onTurnOrderEstablished(List<String> turnOrder)
      Fired at the start of a new round, after the placement order is determined.

    • onEraChanged

      void onEraChanged(Era newEra, List<String> newUpperRowBuildings, List<String> newLowerRowBuildings, List<String> discardedBuildings)
      Fired when the game transitions to a new era and the building market is updated.
      Parameters:
      newEra - the era now in effect
      newUpperRowBuildings - building card IDs now in the upper building market row
      newLowerRowBuildings - building card IDs now in the lower building market row
      discardedBuildings - building card IDs removed from play (Era III lower-row discard)

    • onBoardUpdated

      void onBoardUpdated(List<String> newUpperRow, List<String> newLowerRow, List<String> discardedCards, List<String> movedToLowerRow, int deckRemainingCount)
      Fired at the start of each new round, describing the full card-row diff.
      Parameters:
      newUpperRow - card IDs now in the upper row
      newLowerRow - card IDs now in the lower row
      discardedCards - card IDs removed from play (previous lower row)
      movedToLowerRow - card IDs that shifted from the upper to the lower row
      deckRemainingCount - number of cards still in the tribe deck

    • onCardTaken

      void onCardTaken(String nickname, String cardID, CardType cardType, RowPosition sourceRow)
      Fired each time a player acquires a card from the board.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the acquiring player's nickname
      cardID - the ID of the card taken
      cardType - whether the card is a CHARACTER or a BUILDING
      sourceRow - the row the card was taken from (UPPER or LOWER)

      tileID - the identifier of the occupied tile

    • onPlayerLimitsUpdated

      void onPlayerLimitsUpdated(String nickname, int remainingUpper, int remainingLower)

    • onPlayerResourceChanged

      void onPlayerResourceChanged(String nickname, ResourceType resource, int newValue, int delta)
      Fired whenever a player's resource value changes (food, prestige, shaman stars, etc.).
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player whose resource changed
      resource - the type of resource that changed
      newValue - the new absolute value of the resource after the change
      delta - the signed amount of the change (positive = gain, negative = loss)
